infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow LEATS to access your photo library to upload profile pictures and document images.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow LEATS to save photos to your device library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow LEATS to use your camera to take photos for your profile and delivery support.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LEATS needs your location to show nearby restaurants, calculate delivery fees, and set an accurate drop-off address for your food.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: LEATS needs your location to show nearby restaurants, calculate delivery fees, and set an accurate drop-off address for your food.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: LEATS needs your location to show nearby restaurants, calculate delivery fees, and set an accurate drop-off address for your food.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: LEATS uses your location to show nearby restaurants and stores, calculate accurate delivery fees, and automatically fill in your drop-off address when placing an order. For example, when you open the app, we use your location to display restaurants delivering to your area.

For example, when you open the app, we use your location to display restaurants delivering to your area.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: LEATS uses your location to show nearby restaurants and stores, calculate accurate delivery fees, and automatically fill in your drop-off address when placing an order.
